content:
alex: Quick Q — we need to finalize the chat/completions streaming init shape. One open nit: do we keep a top-level boolean 'prefetch_kv' in the streaming init payload, or move it under 'model_options'? Backwards compatibility with older SDKs is the main concern :thinking:

maria: my 2c: prefer putting it under model_options so it's clearly per-model. But servers should accept legacy top-level bool for a deprecation window.

liam: fwiw server currently runs in strict mode and will reject unknown top-level fields. We can loosen to accept the bool and emit a warning. Deprecation path: accept -> warn -> remove.

jen: Concern: JS SDK parsing expects a fixed shape in the WS handshake. If we change structure it'll break older client parsers. Can we make SDKs read both locations (new + legacy) during transition?

alex: plan suggestion: server accepts both forms, logs a telemetry event when legacy is used. SDKs update to read model_options first then fall back to top-level. I opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4567 (contains server-side acceptor + tests). Pinging ENG-PLAT for review.

sam: small naming nit: can we use 'prefetch_kv_cache' instead of 'prefetch_kv'? explicitness helps public contracts.

maria: +1 on explicit name, but that would break the opt-in flag we shipped earlier named 'prefetch_kv'. How many customers are on the legacy flag?

liam: telemetry shows ~3 tenants used the top-level 'prefetch_kv' in the last 30d — low risk to keep compatibility.

jen: also, FYI we should include a clear example in the SDK migration guide. Example handshake payloads:
```json
// legacy (accepted but deprecated)
{
  "type": "stream_init",
  "model": "oasst-1",
  "prefetch_kv": true
}

// new (preferred)
{
  "type": "stream_init",
  "model": "oasst-1",
  "model_options": {
    "prefetch_kv_cache": true
  }
}
```

alex: decision for now: implement dual-read on server + add telemetry warning when legacy key used. SDKs to parse both and publish migration docs. We'll avoid renaming the live legacy key for now to reduce churn; introduce explicit 'prefetch_kv_cache' in docs and model_options.

sam: file created: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/issues/789 tracking rename/migration and tests for ordering.

jen: one more related point — streaming 'tool_call' events sometimes emit partial args with unordered fragments. We should define ordering guarantees for 'tool_call.arguments' reassembly in the contract. Otherwise different runtimes may reassemble inconsistently.

liam: opened a short issue #798 for tool_call fragment ordering and payload idempotency. Will propose: each fragment has seq_id + total_count; server guarantees ordering on reassembly for a single connection.

alex: action items: (1) eng/runtime (liam) — accept both 'prefetch_kv' and 'model_options.prefetch_kv_cache' + emit deprecation telemetry (2) sdk (jen) — update parsers to read new path then fallback, add unit tests + examples (3) docs (maria) — add deprecation note and migration snippet on the API docs. ETA: EOD Fri for PRs to land.

maria: assigning docs to myself, I'll draft the migration snippet and migration playbook this afternoon.

liam: I'll update the server PR today, running local regression tests now. cc @alex :thumbsup:

ci-bot: PR 4567 — unit tests passed on linux + mac, integration job queued.

alex: thanks all — sounds like a plan. I'll add the tasks to the sprint board and follow up if anything blocks. Closing thread for now :rocket:
